The '''1994–95 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 64th since its establishment. It began on 3 September 1994, and concluded on 18 June 1995.

This was the final season in which two points were awarded for a win; going forward this changed to [[Three points for a win|three points]].

|note_VLD=On July 31, 1995, [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] and [[Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]] were relegated to ''[[Segunda División B]]'' for not providing documentation (an [[audit]]) nor making their payments to the [[Royal Spanish Football Federation]] within the time limit. The two best qualified teams to be relegated, [[Albacete Balompié|Albacete]] and [[Real Valladolid|Valladolid]] were readmitted to ''[[La Liga]]''. Later, [[Sevilla FC|Sevilla]] and [[Celta de Vigo|Celta Vigo]] claimed that according to the law<ref>{{cite news |title=Ley de Procedimiento Administrativo |url=http://noticias.juridicas.com/base_datos/Admin/l30-1992.html |access-date=6 November 2010 |language=es}}</ref> they had another 15 [[Business day|working days]] because they made allegations days before. Finally, the solution<ref>{{cite news |title=Temporada 1994-95 (nota aclaratoria de la ampliación a 22 equipos) |url=http://www.futbolme.com/laliga/porjornadas/index2.asp?D1=1994 |publisher=futbolme.com |access-date=6 November 2010 |language=es}}</ref> was to not relegate any involved team and expand the league to 22 teams for the next two seasons.
